correctness.rationale: The helper implements the full inspectable exit contract: PR-number input, allow-list loading with [bot] stripping, head SHA before/after snapshot checks, RESULT=/HEAD= stdout emission, env defaults (INTERVAL=20, QUIET_WINDOW=360, MAX_WAIT=900), and branches for CONVERGED, QUIET_ELAPSED, TIMEOUT, SHA_CHANGED, and API_ERROR. Bats fixtures exercise all five result paths. One minor contract gap: reviews and issue comments are fetched with last:100 only (no pagination), so unusually large PRs could miss bot activity; unresolved-thread counting also omits an isOutdated filter that Phase 4 may apply elsewhere.

quality.rationale: Implementation is clear and repo-consistent (set -euo pipefail, scripts/lib/logging.sh, trap cleanup, dedicated check script). Docs are comprehensively synced: pr-resolve-all.md adds a settle-window dispatch table and points Phase 4 at the canonical allow-list file; AI_REPO_GUIDE.md, scripts/README.md, and scripts/tests/README.md are updated. Minor deduction for maintainability: ~200 lines of inline GraphQL plus a large embedded jq summarize block in one shell file rather than extracted scripts/lib/jq filters used elsewhere in the repo.

process.rationale: Diff is tightly scoped to 10 on-task files (helper, allow-list, bats tests, three check scripts, and required doc/prompt surfaces) with no AGENTS.md, PLAN.md, or live-state churn. pr-resolve-all.md prefers the helper while preserving the documented time-based fallback. Companion maintenance is thorough: required-files inventory, scripts lint inventory, and dedicated scripts/checks/160-pr-resolve-all-poll.sh wiring.

reliability.rationale: scripts/tests/pr-resolve-all-poll.bats provides six mock-gh scenarios (CONVERGED, QUIET_ELAPSED, paginated threads, TIMEOUT, SHA_CHANGED, missing-allowlist API_ERROR) wired via scripts/checks/160-pr-resolve-all-poll.sh and test_wiring 2/2. Objective grading skipped bats execution (bats_poll_helper status skip), so pass status is structurally credible but not runtime-confirmed in this bundle. Minor gap: gh-stub supports PR_POLL_FAIL_GRAPHQL but no test exercises GraphQL API_ERROR.

uncertainty_notes: bats_poll_helper was skipped in objective-grade.json; subjective reliability score assumes the mock-based tests are structurally sound but not execution-verified in this bundle.

citations.claim: hard_gate_pass is true, enabling normal subjective scoring rather than fail-closed zeroing.
emit_result prints RESULT= and HEAD= (when available) plus PARTICIPATING_BOTS, UNRESOLVED_THREADS, LAST_ACTIONABLE_AT, and ELAPSED on stdout before exiting with the documented code.
snapshot_once fetches head_before, base GraphQL snapshot, paginated reviewThreads, and head_after; exits 3 with RESULT=SHA_CHANGED when head values diverge.
Main loop exits 0 CONVERGED when jq .converged is true, 0 QUIET_ELAPSED when quiet_elapsed >= QUIET_WINDOW, and 2 TIMEOUT when waited >= MAX_WAIT.
api_error and prerequisite failures emit RESULT=API_ERROR with exit 4 for missing gh/jq/date/sleep, missing allow-list, and fetch/parse failures.
fetch_base_snapshot queries reviews(last:100) and comments(last:100) without pagination beyond the first 100 nodes.
summarize_snapshot jq counts unresolved threads where root_login is allow-listed and isResolved==false, without filtering isOutdated.
scripts/lib/bot-allowlist.txt lists eight normalized bot identities shared by the helper and pr-resolve-all.md Phase 4.
pr-resolve-all.md adds settle-window helper preference with exit/result dispatch table and retains documented time-based fallback language.
scripts/tests/pr-resolve-all-poll.bats _legacy_body asserts exit codes and RESULT= strings for converged, quiet-elapsed, paginated-thread, timeout, sha-changed, and missing-allowlist scenarios.
scripts/checks/160-pr-resolve-all-poll.sh invokes run_bats_check for scripts/tests/pr-resolve-all-poll.bats and greps prompt/docs for helper and fallback references.
bash_n_poll_helper and lint_poll_helper passed; bats_poll_helper skipped; test_wiring matched 2/2 patterns (6/6 objective reliability points for wiring).
Ten focused files spanning helper, allow-list, bats tests, checks, and doc/prompt surfaces with no unrelated scope.
